## Hi, I'm Courtney


I came to data science from a computer science background and a desire to be more connected with data and those it can serve. What keeps me here is working with data and projects that have a real impact. Seeing a deployed dashboard assist real stakeholders because of my work keeps me in data science. I love working with all kinds of data and projects that have a real impact.

At Willamette my focus has been data engineering and data analysis. My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🌲 I am an avid choral singer and I love to try new recipes.
- 🎯 I aspire to continue learning new techniques and approaches to data science.
